## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Suprabha Mahal?
No. 22, Vellalar Street, Mogappair West, Chennai 600 037.

### What facilities does Suprabha Mahal have?
Fully air-conditioned, Reception hall, Dining hall, Modern kitchen, A/C rooms, Lift, Car parking, Engagements, Marriages & receptions, Upanayanam, Naming ceremonies, Conferences & seminars.

### Is there a smaller hall?
Yes. Suprabha Mini Hall A/C is in the same building, with its own reception hall, dining hall, kitchen and room.

### Can we hold a meeting or seminar here?
Yes — conferences, seminars, training programmes, product launches, dealer meets and board meetings.

### How do I book Suprabha Mahal?
